items.title: File Anchorage business personal property return
items.description: Businesses operating in Anchorage on January 1 with assets over $20,000 file the Business Property Assessment Return by April 30 (postmarked; meter strips are not accepted); late returns carry a 10% penalty. The first $100,000 of assessed value of taxable personal property per taxpayer is exempt from municipal tax from 2026. A sold or closed business still files to say so.

note: Only business personal property was checked at municipal level.
